guidance.bestFor: The minimal read only display: a whole score of 4 at the default size with no number shown
A half star score of 3.5, drawn as 3 full stars and a fourth filled halfway, with no number

whenNotToUse.when: A fractional score that also prints its number after the stars

guidance.bestFor: A 4.5 score with its value printed after the stars to 1 decimal place in muted text
A click to score input that starts empty, prints the hovered or picked number and confirms each pick with a toast
agentNotes: `handleRatingChange` only sets `productRating` and raises a `toast`, which needs a mounted Sonner toaster; save the score there
The `toast.success` title is a plain string that prints {rating} as typed; only the `description` template fills in the score

whenNotToUse.when: A fixed score shown with its number that the reader cannot change

guidance.bestFor: The sm, default and lg sizes stacked at the same score of 4 to compare star size and spacing

whenNotToUse.when: A score the user sets by clicking a star

guidance.bestFor: A ratings overview: a large average over small stars and a review total, then a yellow count bar per star level
agentNotes: The 4.6 score and Based on 200 reviews line are typed in, while the `distribution` counts average 4.4; derive both from your data
Bar length reads `percentage`, stored apart from `count` in each row; compute it from the counts when you load real reviews

guidance.bestFor: A star input preset to 3.5 with a line under it echoing the chosen score out of 5
agentNotes: The 3.5 preset in `useState` is the only half value it shows; every click through `setRating` lands on a whole star

whenNotToUse.when: A score the user must pick in half or finer steps

guidance.bestFor: A 5 face scale from Terrible to Amazing on plain buttons, naming the chosen mood under the row
agentNotes: Built on plain buttons over the `emojis` list, not `Rating`, and the pick stays in local `selected` state until you send it
Each button is named by its emoji alone and marks the pick with styling only; give it its `label` text and a pressed state

guidance.bestFor: A review card: a star input, a reply line that shifts with the score, a comment box and a Submit locked until a pick
agentNotes: The Submit Review `Button` has no handler and no form around it; send `rating` and `review` to your API from it

whenNotToUse.when: A quick star pick with no written comment to collect
